newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: OB Brewery to absorb Doo San Beverage. [CORRECTED 08:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: OB Brewery to absorb Doo San Beverage. [CORRECTED 08:00 GMT]

text.p: South Korea's leading beer maker OB Brewery Co plans to absorb its sister firm, Doo San Beverage Co, on October 1, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Tuesday.

In a statement released by the board, OB Brewery said it had decided to absorb the sister firm to integrate beverage and food production operations, which would help the company reduce logistics costs and improve cash flow.
The plan was subject to approval at special shareholders' meetings of both companies due to be held on July 4, the statement said.
After the absorption, OB Brewery's paid-in capital would rise to 49.52 billion won from 33.54 billion, the statement said.
OB Brewery plans to issue 100 common shares for every 115.37 common shares of Doo San Beverage and 100 preferred shares for every 128.55 preferred shares of Doo San, the statement said.
OB Brewery posted a net loss of 96.41 billion won in calendar 1996 on turnover of 1.04 trillion won, while Doo San ran a 3.57 billion won net profit.
(Corrects Doo San's net figures, and changes to profit from loss).
